# A documented case carries a reader path of its own

## Statement
Where the material documents a case at a named company, the strongest reader
path runs from the case to what went wrong, to how it is done right, to what
transfers. Retelling the case without the transfer leaves the reader nothing.

## Applies when
feature documented_case is yes and feature named_company is yes

## Influences
- S-08 · `E-13.reader_path` — the ordered moves the strategy proposes.
- S-08 · `E-13.ending_intention` — what the ending has to transfer.

## Conflicts
None known.

## Source
Observed across the client's own published cases; map §8.3, K-MAT-02.
